name: Ready Metal Card
summary: Premium self-custodial Mastercard with 3% STRK cashback (10% first 30 days). Zero FX fees, zero conversion fees. Funds stay in your wallet until you spend.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

faq.question: Does the Ready Metal Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$15 per month. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Ready Metal Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
